item.title: Braves Rotation Shaken: Strider Out with Strained Oblique
item.description: Braves shocker: Ace Spencer Strider to start 2026 season on IL with strained oblique (per Mark Bowman/MLB.com). Expected recovery 2-4 weeks, shaking up the rotation & bullpen early. Depth tested with J.R. Ritchie, Didier Fuentes & Martin Perez in mix; Lucas Giolito rumors swirling. Strider's injury history + $20M deal adds pressure—first 13 games could be rough. Atlanta needs to adapt fast. #Braves #MLB #SpencerStrider #InjuryNews #OpeningDay
